source: Rumazi data signals and instrumentation handoff for Codex, research snapshot 2026-11-13
scope: All 66 candidate rows preserved. This is a candidate mapping, not 66 newly collected signals or a completed-system certificate. No production mutation or new tracking permission by this agent.

feed.observed: Server serve/impression rows in rank_events include recommendation/session provenance; a response is not proof a card was rendered or visible.
feed.retention: rank_events has auth-user cascade; deletionDispositions still lists a governance backlog. No raw-event retention sweep was found in this audit.
feed.ranking: Existing ranking/momentum/fatigue consumers use selected rank_events outcomes. New exposure is not yet a ranking input.

media.observed: MEDIA_ANALYTICS_ENABLED gates the existing service-only media_events store. Client batches now bind to the initiating observed login session, cancel on flag disable, and validate bounded identifiers/codes before transport and ingestion. Server viewer identity is authoritative. Arrival/contribution are server-only. Picker taps no longer claim committed Trip Add/Plan. Create Plan records its actual Compass handoff. Not-interested reports no longer count useful correction. Compiled experience plans emit media_plan only when all proposed stops receive successful create acknowledgements; partial/failure/review handoffs do not.
media.retention: media_events stores viewer/creator identifiers inside payload JSON. No expiry column, retention worker, or explicit account deletion of these JSON identities was found. This blocks expanding collection. Q11(a) in docs/ops/owner-decisions-20261004.md:231 remains a proposed default pending legal review; D6 in deletionDispositions.ts remains open. No unsupported retention or deletion decision was implemented.
media.ranking: MediaRankingSignalLoader.ts reads selected media_events north-star outcomes for utility. Suppressing premature outcomes prevents those taps from inflating utility. No new ranking term is enabled.

wall.observed: Wall has viewability-triggered deduplicated impressions, fixed event taxonomy, and an existing telemetry endpoint. This is partial visibility evidence, not a continuous-qualified exposure segment.
wall.retention: 30-day wall_telemetry_events expiry and flag-independent deletion worker in source; no live execution was verified in this agent task.
wall.ranking: Usefulness metrics are distinct from the Wall content ranking projections.

dwell.observed: Place-sheet dwell distinguishes active, passive foreground and idle and binds to a served recommendation. Its 10-second interaction window is explicitly unratified. It is not feed tile exposure.
dwell.retention: Uses rank_events; expansion requires purpose/retention/consent decisions. Client sender still needs owner-bound lifetime/deadline parity.
dwell.ranking: Passive/idle do not qualify as interest. No active-dwell ranking reader was found.

records.observed: Use canonical save, collection, destination and follow mutations for committed state. Names and access lists remain feature data; do not duplicate them in telemetry.
records.retention: Follows operational entity deletion/access policy. A new durable analytics copy would require its own deletion/retention contract.
records.ranking: Saves and follows are existing explicit preferences; remove/undo must reverse the underlying state, not merely add another engagement event.

trips.observed: Trip/route commands, plan items, route stops and membership state are operational sources. Route creation, arrival and completion have server-side media attribution producers. Opening a picker is not a committed trip add.
trips.retention: Member/owner policies and deletion are product responsibilities; exact dates, notes and membership are excluded from a general analytics expansion.
trips.ranking: Trip context is permissioned feature context. No new cross-purpose export is implemented.

input.observed: Existing input events carry request linkage and per-event allowlisted properties. Raw input is used for the lookup, not retained in the telemetry row. The schema deliberately has no account identifier. Optional outcome learning and memory context have separate consent controls.
input.retention: Outcome learning is a 30-day window with withdrawal deletion; raw telemetry has its existing retention contract. Needs live verification of queues, cleanup and exports, not an assertion from unit tests.
input.ranking: Consented success/reversal aggregates are distinct from core suggestions and from private memory context.

map.observed: Existing Map taxonomy carries session/decision correlation and coarse geohash cells rather than raw coordinates. Routing coordinates remain scoped feature data. Taps/handoffs do not establish visits.
map.retention: 30-day map telemetry contract in source; live retention and downstream export behavior were not verified here.
map.ranking: Permissioned decision context is not a license to infer home/work or sensitive affiliations.

creation.observed: Creation/upload/publish and preview paths exist. Product drafts, selected uploads and explicit preview requests must remain distinct from analytics. No abandoned-text or keystroke collection is added.
creation.retention: Draft, upload and provider deletion require each owning feature policy; general telemetry must not retain payloads.
creation.ranking: Unsent private input is excluded from general recommendation signals.

telegraph.observed: Message, receipt, typing and membership state serve the communication feature. Private content/recipients are not general recommendation inputs.
telegraph.retention: Conversation visibility, erasure and transport controls apply; this audit does not certify all device encryption or member-revocation paths.
telegraph.ranking: No new private-message or social-graph analytics extraction.

diagnostics.observed: Sentry SDKs and 10% production tracing are configured. No central beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb scrub was present at the inspected init sites. Dependency manifests show Sentry, not an installed Segment/Mixpanel/Amplitude/PostHog SDK; this is not a network-export audit.
diagnostics.retention: External Sentry project settings, captured payloads and deletion/retention remain unverified.
diagnostics.ranking: Diagnostics are for reliability, not profiling; do not reuse device-wide states as interest traits.

sensing.observed: Existing Sensing has feature-scoped consent/capture/revocation paths. Presence/sensor processing must not be repurposed as general feed telemetry or inferred attention.
sensing.retention: Existing sensing consent, atomic admission and revocation govern the feature. Split disclosure approval, live retention and physical-device evidence are separate gates.
sensing.ranking: Only authorized reduced observations may reach the owning feature. Raw readings and sensitive inferences remain excluded.

implemented.change: Bind existing media analytics queue/transport to the action-time observed owner session; abort on disable; bounded queue/dedup/in-flight transport and background flush
Reject unknown payload fields, caller viewer identity, raw error prose and malformed/oversized values before client transmission and server ingestion
Reject client-forged media_arrival and media_contribution; preserve server-confirmed producers

implemented.evidence: mediaTelemetry mapping and real media rail/panel component tests distinguish navigation, pending or partial writes, dismissal, session changes and full compiled-plan acknowledgement.

validation.eslint: No errors; pre-existing any/ref warnings remain on shared media panel files

requiredExternalInputs: Approved purpose, recipients, retention and user controls before new feed behavioral collection is activated. The handoff proposes 30 days as an example, not a final policy.
Authenticated test accounts and approved deployment for live payload/storage/export and real device lifecycle/accessibility/performance verification.
Sentry project configuration/export access to verify downstream recipients, retention and real captured data.
unblockedFollowup: Continuous qualified feed exposure should be integrated only after the consent/retention contract is explicit; serving/mounting is not exposure.
Central diagnostic scrubbing at Sentry startup and downstream export verification.

Wire generic Add to Trip and legacy experience-picker committed media attribution through canonical mutation provenance; no event is emitted merely for opening those pickers. Factual correction acknowledgement needs its own producer; not_interested is not that outcome.
Media view admission/access/session binding, durable idempotency and persisted receipts are under implementation; playback summaries and qualified exposure remain separate open work.
Discovery dwell still needs account/lifetime parity audit.

Media identity erasure boundary and disabled retention proposal are implemented; finalize exact-byte native race gates and full rollout. Legal review for retention and legacy unlinked/orphaned data gaps remain open.

candidates.candidate: Feed request, response, eligible candidate set, ranking source, displayed position
candidates.proposed_use: Correlate exposure with request and surface. Keep candidate counts and ranker version. Full candidate lists belong in sampled debugging if needed.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Serve provenance exists; eligible candidate counts/version coverage must be checked per endpoint. Never relabel served rows as viewed.

candidates.candidate: Returned but never rendered, rendered but off-screen, partially visible, sufficiently visible
candidates.proposed_use: Track delivery failures and real opportunities to see a destination. Avoid counting prefetch or virtualized off-screen mounts.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Wall knows viewable items; there is no common delivered/rendered/visible contract across feeds.

candidates.candidate: Entry, exit, visible duration, visible fraction, qualified exposure, repeated exposure
candidates.proposed_use: Evaluate which guides and places people pause on. Distinguish exposure segments from unique content per session.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: No shared continuous 50%-for-1s qualified feed-exposure lifecycle; place-sheet dwell is separate.

candidates.candidate: Fast scroll-past, pause, scroll back, return later, session resume
candidates.proposed_use: Use bounded duration and revisit buckets. Avoid uploading a raw touch or scroll trace.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Do not add raw scroll traces. Define purpose and bounded revisit buckets first.

candidates.candidate: Post card tap, expand caption, open comments, open creator profile, close detail
candidates.proposed_use: Identify what earns deeper exploration. Record resulting surface and entry point.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Several open/action signals exist; caption expansion, comments opening and close-detail coverage varies.

candidates.candidate: Carousel position, first or last image reached, backward swipe, zoom, full-screen view
candidates.proposed_use: Identify useful imagery and where guides are dropped. Keep slide number or count and a content ID.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Viewer gestures exist as product behavior, but a complete slide/zoom telemetry emitter was not established.

candidates.candidate: Autoplay eligible, started, manual play, pause, seek, loop, completion, replay
candidates.proposed_use: Separate actual playback from visible time. Capture one bounded summary with foreground and user-initiated flags.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Watch playback state exists; declared completion/rewatch types are not proof of a playback-summary producer.

candidates.candidate: Muted autoplay, user mutes or unmutes, captions enabled, playback speed
candidates.proposed_use: Honor explicit media preferences and measure feature use. Keep choices scoped to the player.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Own-player mute/caption controls exist. Do not inspect device-wide audio settings for ranking.

candidates.candidate: Translation offered or used, accessibility labels, captions missing, transcript expanded
candidates.proposed_use: Find inaccessible guides. Measure the feature action and supported language at an appropriate granularity. Avoid using disability or accessibility status as a ranking trait.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Captions/translation features exist. Measure feature errors/actions without classifying accessibility status.

candidates.candidate: Like and undo, follow and unfollow, show less, hide, mute, block, report
candidates.proposed_use: Keep operational records where needed. Use explicit feedback for ranking, and keep safety actions scoped to their purpose. Preserve undo semantics.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Keep explicit product mutations and undo semantics. Safety reports/blocks stay purpose-scoped.

candidates.candidate: Ad or sponsored result impression and dismissal
candidates.proposed_use: If sponsorship exists, mark the placement, position, and campaign. Separate ads reporting from organic recommendation evaluation.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Sponsorship must be established and governed before ad-placement measurement is introduced.

candidates.candidate: Save or unsave a post, place, guide, route, event, or creator
candidates.proposed_use: Use the canonical record with object type, object ID, and visibility. A successful save can outrank dwell as an explicit interest signal.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Use authoritative save state for supported object types; do not infer successful saves from button taps.

candidates.candidate: Open saved items, revisit item, reorder or move item, remove or archive
candidates.proposed_use: Understand retrieval and cleanup. A removed save should reverse or decay its contribution.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Retrieval/removal records exist in parts; a consistent revisit/open funnel is not yet established.

candidates.candidate: Create, rename, archive, or delete collection, change visibility, add or remove collaborator
candidates.proposed_use: Support private, shared, and public states if the product offers them. Keep names, notes, and access lists in product storage.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Collection metadata and ownership are operational data; do not export names or collaborators.

candidates.candidate: Save into one or several collections, deduplicate, import from an explicit share action
candidates.proposed_use: Track source and action outcome. Avoid duplicating pasted links or private collection titles in logs.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Reuse collection save and destination commits and existing idempotency; link/import provenance needs a defined consumer.

candidates.candidate: Save → revisit → add to itinerary → directions or partner click
candidates.proposed_use: Measure the move from inspiration to planning. Label outbound clicks as handoffs. Confirm a visit or purchase only from a separate qualifying action.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Existing action events are partial. The action rail emits media_trip_add/media_plan before commitment; that must be corrected before calling this a completed funnel.

candidates.candidate: Trip created or abandoned, destination added, trip dated or undated, archived or canceled
candidates.proposed_use: Use trip stage for reminders and recommendations where enabled. Derive stage from product state. Keep exact travel dates out of general analytics.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Derive stage from trip lifecycle; abandonment needs a separately defined bounded window.

candidates.candidate: Add/remove stop, change order or day, pin, duplicate, replace, mark optional
candidates.proposed_use: Support planning, undo, and useful recommendations. Use committed edits as the source of truth.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Committed trip commands are the source; do not duplicate names, dates or notes in analytics.

candidates.candidate: Trip filters, explicit budget band, group size band, activity interests, transport preference
candidates.proposed_use: Personalize the current trip if users provide the information. Make preferences editable and scoped to the trip.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Trip-scoped preferences require editable feature context; no general analytics export added.

candidates.candidate: Invite created, sent, joined, declined, expired, revoked
candidates.proposed_use: Diagnose collaboration adoption. Keep invitation tokens and addresses out of analytics.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Invite lifecycle is operational; tokens and recipient details excluded.

candidates.candidate: Collaborator role changes, votes, notes, assignment, comments on a stop
candidates.proposed_use: Measure aggregate collaboration outcomes. Preserve member-only visibility, and keep text and membership in product storage.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Member-scoped role/vote/comment data must stay in its access domain.

candidates.candidate: Offline save, download, sync retry, conflict, merge, sync complete
candidates.proposed_use: Track local action and server reconciliation separately. Count the eventual successful mutation once.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Some owner-bound upload queues exist; a unified local/committed sync metric is not established.

candidates.candidate: Check-in, mark visited, trip review, itinerary completion
candidates.proposed_use: Prefer user-confirmed visits and check-ins. Consider coarse analytics counts if a concrete metric needs them.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Confirmed checkpoint/route/gem actions can establish arrival; directions handoff cannot.

candidates.candidate: Search entry, query submitted, known destination or category selected, suggestion selected
candidates.proposed_use: Use canonical place/category IDs where possible. Record free-form search only where needed to serve the request, with any diagnostic capture separately reviewed.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Use input request IDs and structured selection; free text only serves the lookup.

candidates.candidate: Partial input, reformulation, cleared input, query canceled
candidates.proposed_use: Autocomplete can process the minimum text needed. For analytics, prefer a structured outcome or submission count. Avoid persistent partial input and per-keystroke logging.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Autocomplete necessarily processes input; no persistent partial-input/per-keystroke analytics expansion.

candidates.candidate: Filter applied/reset, sort change, results count bucket, zero results, result selected
candidates.proposed_use: Find relevance and inventory gaps. Log allowlisted filter families, result rank, and stable category IDs.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Existing search/map taxonomy covers parts; exact filter/result-count/rank coverage needs per-surface validation.

candidates.candidate: Search abandoned, no click, next search, results error
candidates.proposed_use: Distinguish empty inventory, latency/error, and a session that ends without selection. An abandonment flag can be derived with a bounded window.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Input request errors/fallbacks exist; session-end abandonment requires bounded semantics.

candidates.candidate: Place detail view, guide opened, source and rank, return to results
candidates.proposed_use: Understand discovery paths. Record a place ID and originating surface.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Place-open and recommendation-bound dwell exist; guide and return-to-results coverage is partial.

candidates.candidate: Directions, hours, website, menu, call, address copy, accessibility or language details
candidates.proposed_use: Treat each action as an intent signal with a distinct meaning. Keep destination URLs free of credentials and user-supplied query strings in telemetry.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Directions/open actions exist. Hours/call/menu/address-copy need specific event coverage; no URL query strings.

candidates.candidate: Map opened, initial area, zoom band, map/list toggle, search this area
candidates.proposed_use: Prefer user-confirmed area IDs and viewport actions. A map center can reflect browsing a future destination.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Map taxonomy/session decisions exist; user-selected destination must stay distinct from physical location.

candidates.candidate: Pin impression, pin tap, cluster expansion, map card open
candidates.proposed_use: Use taps and opens as the initial signals. Measure pin impressions only if density and visibility can be bounded.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Object interactions exist in parts; dense-pin impressions are not validated qualified exposures.

candidates.candidate: Pan, zoom, gesture start/end, viewport history
candidates.proposed_use: Measure coarse interaction count or final selected area when needed. Continuous camera coordinates can reveal detailed planning patterns.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Do not add continuous viewport histories. Any coarse interaction metric needs purpose/retention first.

candidates.candidate: Near me, current location, coarse area, location permission result
candidates.proposed_use: Offer manual city entry. Use a foreground request tied to the feature. Preserve the difference between user-selected destination and physical location.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Foreground feature request/manual city alternative; no background physical-location inference.

candidates.candidate: Route origin, destination, ETA, reroute, navigation handoff
candidates.proposed_use: Route features may need coordinates in transit. Keep request data scoped to routing. A directions tap alone does not establish a visit.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Use route operational state; coarse intent measurement is separate from route coordinates.

candidates.candidate: Live route sharing, geofences, repeated visits, background location
candidates.proposed_use: These can expose whereabouts and travel routines. Consider live sharing only as an explicit time-limited feature with a visible stop control and revocable access.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Existing live-sharing/geofence features require explicit scoped access and stop/revoke verification; no analytics reuse.

candidates.candidate: Partner link click, availability check, price alert, checkout start, failed checkout, cancellation, refund
candidates.proposed_use: Track the last observable state and failure code. Keep payment data, traveler identity, and itinerary details in the operational system.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Partner/commerce availability and commercial scope must be confirmed; never call a click a booking.

candidates.candidate: Booking confirmation, conversion attribution, commission reconciliation
candidates.proposed_use: Accept a supported partner confirmation with a bounded click ID and deduplicate it. Use coarse product categories in analytics where necessary.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Requires actual supported confirmation, attribution/commission policy and deduplication proof.

candidates.candidate: Merchant wishlist, cart, lead form, purchases on unrelated sites
candidates.proposed_use: Advertising systems can collect these through partner integrations. Rumazi’s initial scope has no dependency on them.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Unrelated merchant behavior is excluded from this proposal.

candidates.candidate: Open composer, select type, begin edit, close empty, discard non-empty, resume
candidates.proposed_use: If a completion problem justifies measurement, emit at most one outcome per composer session with a surface enum and outcome. The text itself, exact length, edit history, and typing rhythm provide no necessary input to that funnel.
candidates.coverage: implemented and controlled-test verified for the named flows; deployment/device/export acceptance pending
candidates.observed_and_remaining: User explicitly requested structured abandoned-action outcomes. Six composer_outcome values now distinguish leaving, discard, upload cancellation/failure, post discard after upload and publication. No content/length/recipient payload. Code and controlled tests pass; deployed/device/export validation still open.

candidates.candidate: Local draft created, edited, autosaved, restored, expired, or deleted
candidates.proposed_use: Store locally by default where compatible with product behavior. Distinguish draft state from submission and server receipt.
candidates.coverage: implemented and controlled-test verified for the named flows; deployment/device/export acceptance pending
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Account/composer-scoped local comment and supported post draft recovery implemented. Success/discard clears; failed submission preserves. Controlled restart, browser IndexedDB and account-switch checks documented; physical restart/termination and deployed access still open.

candidates.candidate: Explicit cloud draft sync, collaboration, autosave, duplicate recovery
candidates.proposed_use: If supported, define audience, sync behavior, retention, and delete semantics. Reuse existing product storage for content. Analytics needs a result code at most.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Requires a documented cloud-draft audience, retention and deletion contract.

candidates.candidate: Unsent comments, captions, DMs, pasted text, edit buffers, keystrokes, cursor movements
candidates.proposed_use: Keep raw input out of events, session replay, crash breadcrumbs, remote debug logs, and third-party analytics. Analyze abandonment through the minimal outcome above.
candidates.coverage: implemented and controlled-test verified for the named flows; deployment/device/export acceptance pending
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Raw unsent content remains excluded; composer/client/server schemas and central Sentry scrubber are tested. Hosted crash/export capture is not yet verified.

candidates.candidate: Mention, hashtag, place, or link preview request
candidates.proposed_use: These features can transmit data before publish. Send only the lookup needed by the feature and keep payloads out of event logs. Review any preview destination and third-party exposure.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Lookup and previews are scoped feature requests, not authorization to retain content in analytics.

candidates.candidate: Media picker, capture, select, upload started, upload failed, draft canceled
candidates.proposed_use: Treat permission, import, on-device transform, temporary server upload, and publish as separate steps. A provider failure should appear as a redacted code.
candidates.coverage: implemented and controlled-test verified for the named flows; deployment/device/export acceptance pending
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Private pre-publication upload state, idempotent cancellation/finalization and cleanup races implemented in4028, applied CI/production; client/API deployment pending. Structured failure codes only; saved drafts preserve media.

candidates.candidate: Crop, trim, blur faces, audio selection, translation, captions, moderation before publish
candidates.proposed_use: Prefer on-device processing when practical. For an explicitly requested cloud tool, scope the upload, document retention, and expire temporary objects after cancel or failure. Remove unneeded metadata such as embedded GPS before publication where compatible with the feature.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Use explicit selected content and the owning feature/provider consent/deletion contract.

candidates.candidate: Publish success/failure, edit, delete, restore, moderation decision, appeal
candidates.proposed_use: Use server outcomes and separate access controls for moderation evidence. Keep text and attachment contents in the product or moderation store.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Use server publish/edit/delete/moderation outcomes; separate evidence access.

candidates.candidate: Share sheet opened, returned, handoff available, copied link, invite redeemed
candidates.proposed_use: Separate intent, handoff, and redemption. OS callbacks and browser APIs have different semantics. Avoid reporting a recipient when the system never provided one. [Web Share behavior][webshare]
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Share UI handoff is not delivery. Only invite redemption proves redemption.

candidates.candidate: Message send, delivered, read, typing, reaction, unsend
candidates.proposed_use: Use metadata where necessary to deliver the user-facing feature. Typing can be ephemeral. Read receipts and presence need the product’s visibility rules. Avoid using private communications for general recommendations.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Receipts/presence remain communication features, not recommendation signals.

candidates.candidate: Group join/leave, event RSVP, meetup invite, member discovery, follow graph
candidates.proposed_use: Support group and event access and user-selected discovery. Private group membership and meetup logistics can reveal sensitive affiliations or whereabouts.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Keep membership/RSVP/invite visibility rules; do not derive sensitive affiliations.

candidates.candidate: Address-book sync, contact matching, inferred social graph
candidates.proposed_use: Prefer explicit invite links and allow direct invites without importing an address book. Other people’s contact uploads can reveal non-users’ information.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: No broad address-book or inferred social-graph analytics introduced.

candidates.proposed_scope: Exclude from analytics for device-wide states
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Device-wide audio/ringer/Focus states excluded; explicit player choices are separate.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, orientation, speed, altitude, steps
candidates.proposed_use: Compass or route features can use needed readings while active. Keep continuous readings and motion histories out of discovery analytics.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Needed active-feature readings only; no continuous sensor history in analytics.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Stationary, walking, running, cycling, in vehicle, confidence or unknown
candidates.proposed_use: If a defined navigation feature needs a context mode, prefer a manual control. Evaluate ephemeral on-device classification only if useful. Treat unknown as a normal state.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Activity classification cannot infer driver/passenger or sitting/standing; manual/unknown remain valid.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Phone facing down, proximity, ambient light, charging, low power, battery level
candidates.proposed_use: These are device conditions with ambiguous behavioral meaning. Collect coarse battery or performance diagnostics only if tied to an observed problem.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Later diagnostic-only; no behavioral meaning inferred from phone posture/battery.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Eye direction, blink, pupil response, facial expression, voiceprints, ambient microphone
candidates.proposed_use: Skip passive collection. Optional camera tools should have a clear user action and visible feature state. A gaze or expression estimate gives weak evidence of interest or emotion.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Passive gaze/face/voiceprint/ambient recording excluded from general analytics. Existing acoustic feature does not authorize that reuse.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: GPS, IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth beacons, cell network, location metadata
candidates.proposed_use: Use network data where necessary for operations and abuse prevention. For discovery use a user-chosen area or scoped location request. Avoid SSIDs, nearby device IDs, precise location histories, and broker data in analytics.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Feature location and abuse operations are distinct from analytics. No SSID/device-ID/location-history expansion.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Contact book, calendar, photo library, clipboard, wearable or health data
candidates.proposed_use: Use system pickers, explicit paste, and scoped integrations when a feature requires them. Avoid background clipboard reads and broad library import. A feature grant does not imply a new analytics use.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: System pickers/explicit paste/scoped calendar integrations only; no background clipboard or broad library analytics.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Advertising IDs, fingerprinting, cross-app linking, data brokers, session replay
candidates.proposed_use: Review SDK defaults and downstream recipients. Apple prohibits fingerprinting. Exclude session replay on editors, chat, account, maps, and travel plans from the initial scope.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: No advertising ID, fingerprint/broker/session-replay integration added. Existing SDK export verification remains necessary.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Predicted interest, destination affinity, travel stage, group fit
candidates.proposed_use: Prefer explicit saves, categories, and trip actions. Track provenance and expiry. “Saved Lisbon cafes” supports a content preference. It cannot establish current residence, location, or planned travel dates.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Explicit preferences and consented outcome memory exist. Evidence does not establish physical location or travel dates.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: Home/work, routine, relationship, religion, health, sexuality, immigration status, vulnerability
candidates.proposed_use: Precise location and repeated visits can expose sensitive patterns. Exclude these inferences from recommendation and advertising systems.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Sensitive personal/affiliation/location-routine inferences are excluded from recommendations and ads.

candidates.group: App lifecycle, devices, sensors, and inference
candidates.candidate: AI prompts, generated plans, feedback, accepted or edited suggestions
candidates.proposed_use: If an AI planner exists, keep prompt and output in the intended feature store, with retention and provider scope documented. Analytics can use structured tool/result type, latency, error, or accept/edit/dismiss outcome.
candidates.coverage: partial; code audit only, not acceptance-complete
candidates.observed_and_remaining: Feature prompts/outputs stay in intended stores; analytics uses allowlisted result/latency/outcome metadata.
